2 خطّط , inf. n. تَخْطِيطٌ, [He marked with lines, streaks, or stripes. Also] He wove a piece of cloth with lines, streaks, or stripes. (KL.) And He drew lines well and elegantly. (KL.) ―
-b2- See also 1, in two places, in the latter half of the paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
